nodes.name: GHL: Clear Context (anomaly)

httpMultipleHeadersAuth.name: GHL [ Waterline Growth subaccount ] Multiple Headers Auth account

nodes.notes: Anomaly = we cannot attribute this call to a caller stage. Blanks Call Router Context + Call Processing State so the PREVIOUS call's context can't be reused: without this the Dispatcher still fires on the disposition webhook, reads the stale ctx, and moves the wrong opp. Deliberately NOT continueRegularOutput — a failed clear must surface, since it leaves the stale-context bug live.

nodes.name: Anomaly (capture for later)
nodes.notes: STUB: captures anomalous calls ('none' / 'multiple'). Anomalies STOP here — context is CLEARED (previous node), no new context stored, no fallback fired. $json.anomaly distinguishes the two. Expand later (alert / manual-review).

nodes.name: Gate: append transcript?
